situations.headline: VSee Health enters $5M equity line (STRATA) with ClearThink Capital at 85% of lowest 10-day close

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: VSee Health enters $5M equity line (STRATA) with ClearThink Capital at 85% of lowest 10-day close (interest 3, risk 8)

thesis.text: VSee Health is a micro-cap telehealth SPAC-derived company relying on a discounted equity line (STRATA) with ClearThink Capital to fund operations, structurally diluting shareholders via shares sold at 85% of lowest 10-day closing price; absent a clear growth or catalyst narrative in the filing, this is a financing-survival situation warranting caution rather than a compounder thesis, judgement.
